title: Router failures are reported from one shared place for every chat surface (web, Discord, YouTube)
evidence: runRouter (app/lib/chat-router-stage.server.ts) runs the router for api.chat.ts, platform-chat.server.ts and youtube-bot-pipeline.server.ts and applies each caller's report policy: per failed turn with the platform tag (web, Discord), one count per tick (YouTube, reportTickFallbacks). Tests: app/lib/chat-router-report.test.ts, app/routes/api.chat-masters.test.ts; app/lib/chat-entry-set.pin.test.ts pins routeQuery's one caller (US-15 AC74). (H414)
